label: Strict comparison and non-reciprocity
summary: a4814f25-84b0-560e-870a-eb3a23a6a35b (Primitive): 1fe8fd6f, 482f4ad2, 4d1efe91 and 69e63caf use asymmetry of the supplied MoreIn. Conceptual warrant is strong when it is a strict comparison of the same perfection in the same sense and respect, as follows from strict comparison of calibrated degrees. The current predicate is independent of that calibration. A weak comparison admits ties and reciprocal comparisons, and comparisons along different dimensions do not yield a common strict order. An esse-only restriction is sufficient where the consumer only instantiates at esse. Retain as a candidate order law under the strict same-respect interpretation.
